card.name: Words just before 'amount of' phrases
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs right before a quantity phrase such as 'amount(s) of', e.g. 'aid of', 'uses large', 'with copious', 'produces more'. It fires where the next word is likely 'amount' or a similar quantity word.

modes.example: this<< produces>> more bilirubin than the liver
